list_modes.source_shape: unique typed value and display-label pairs

validation_profiles.FIXED_CHOICE: Exact canonical token from the declared choices; presentation case does not change the stored token.
validation_profiles.TEXT: Nonempty UTF-8 string after policy normalization, no control characters, within configured byte and code-point limits.
validation_profiles.NUMBER: Finite base-10 integer or decimal; NaN, infinity, expressions, units, and locale-dependent separators are rejected.
validation_profiles.DATE: Valid calendar date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD; locale-dependent or ambiguous dates are rejected.
validation_profiles.LIST: Exactly one declared option selected under KEY, INDEX, or VALUE mode; duplicate keys or values and out-of-range indices are rejected.

actions.effect: Validate the value, then attempt the single OPEN-to-SETTLED compare-and-set with ANSWERED.
Clear only the initiating client's uncommitted draft; prompt revision, deadline, attempts, and durable state do not change.
Attempt the single OPEN-to-SETTLED compare-and-set with CANCELLED; it is not an execution kill.

default_policy.validation: A default must validate under the same type and option revision as an operator answer.
default_policy.timeout_use: A validated explicit default may settle ANSWERED when the response deadline wins; otherwise deadline expiry settles TIMED_OUT and never invents a value.
default_policy.zero_timeout: Normalize legacy zero to no response deadline; it does not create an immediate settlement.

settings.effect: Emit an accessible visual and optional audible warning without settling or extending the prompt.
Pin one database-time response deadline when the prompt opens.
Bound how long an open prompt may remain without a controller before NO_CONTROLLER may win.

race_loser_rule: Return the immutable winning SettlementId and outcome; never reopen, retry, or replace it.
invalid_attempt_rule: Record a bounded rejected attempt without changing PromptRevision, deadline, or prompt state.

controller_loss_and_recovery.prompt_result: Remain OPEN with the same PromptId and deadline while the execution enters SUSPENDED with hold_reason CONTROL_LOST.
controller_loss_and_recovery.authority: No monitor or background session may answer.

controller_loss_and_recovery.prompt_result: Republish the same PromptId and revision to the authenticated new holder; explicit resume restores PROMPT.
controller_loss_and_recovery.authority: The new active lease and fence are required for COMMIT or ABORT.

controller_loss_and_recovery.prompt_result: Republish the same PromptId, original database deadline, warning state, settings snapshot, and attempts.
controller_loss_and_recovery.authority: Restart grants no lease and resets no timer.

controller_loss_and_recovery.prompt_result: Return the single stored settlement and never present an answerable prompt.

secret_policy: Secret or password responses are outside this v0.6 family; plaintext secrets are rejected and never stored in events, logs, audit, browser persistence, or as-run views.
